== Title ==

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">任意のロケーションカード上に配備し、</span> [Dark Force icon] <span lang="ja">と</span> [Light Force icon] <span lang="ja">を１つずつ加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-227o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">土地は、そこに刻まれた歴史によって様々な相を見せる。かくてフォースは、「…銀河を一つにまとめ」満ちて、また引く。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Card text:''' Deploy on any location card and add one Dark Force icon and one Light Force icon.

'''Lore:''' Places take on different aspects according to the history etched into them. Thus the Force, which “binds the galaxy together,” ebbs and flows.
